name: Ahrefs
tagline: SEO and AI-search platform built on large web, keyword, and backlink datasets

pricing.notes: Official pricing URL checked; 2026 public coverage lists a Starter tier around $29/month, with larger tiers much higher.

tiers.name: Ahrefs Free
tiers.limits: Unlimited verified owned projects; limited Site Explorer and Site Audit access; numeric report/credit caps are not published on the pricing card.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.limits: Limited Site Explorer, Site Audit and Keywords Explorer access; numeric caps are not published on the main pricing card.

tiers.name: Lite
tiers.limits: 5 unverified projects; 750 tracked keywords; 5 tracked AI prompts; 100,000 crawl credits/month; 1,000 credits/user/month; 1 user.
tiers.notes: Annual billing saves up to 17%, but the exact annual rate was not exposed.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.limits: 20 unverified projects; 2,000 tracked keywords; 10 AI prompts; 500,000 crawl credits/month; 1 user.
tiers.notes: Annual billing saves up to 17%, but the exact annual rate was not exposed.

tiers.name: Advanced
tiers.limits: 50 unverified projects; 5,000 tracked keywords; 20 AI prompts; 1,500,000 crawl credits/month; 1 user.
tiers.notes: Annual billing saves up to 17%, but the exact annual rate was not exposed.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.limits: From 3 users; 100 unverified projects; from 10,000 tracked keywords; from 5M crawl credits/month.
tiers.notes: Starts at $1,499/month with an annual commitment.

tiers.name: Brand Radar AI
tiers.limits: Standalone access starts at $199/month; searches a database of 271M+ organic prompts.
tiers.notes: Exact included custom-prompt allowance depends on configuration.

pricing.freeTierCaps: free for verified owned sites; unlimited verified projects, but numeric report and credit caps are not published on the main pricing card
pricing.billingTerms: monthly for self-service plans; annual billing available with savings up to 17%; Enterprise requires an annual commitment
pricing.hiddenCosts: extra users cost $40/$60/$80 per month on Lite/Standard/Advanced; Enterprise extra users are $100/month; custom-prompt packages cost $50/$100/$250 monthly with $0.020/$0.015/$0.010 per-check overages; PAYG data expires after 3 billing months; add-ons include Content Kit from $99/month, Report Builder $99/month, and Project Boost at $20 or $200 per project/month

verdictSummary: You can build a keyword tracker or site audit script, but Ahrefs' value is its proprietary web crawl, backlink index, keyword data, SERP data, and historical datasets.
coreLoopDIY: For one site, crawl pages, check technical SEO, track a small keyword list, and call search APIs where available.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay for the dataset, not the dashboard.

priorArt.name: Screaming Frog alternatives: SEO Macroscope
priorArt.desc: Open-source website crawler for technical SEO; does not replace Ahrefs' external data moat

rejectedAlternatives.name: Ahrefs Webmaster Tools
rejectedAlternatives.desc: Excellent on sites you can verify; the moment you ask about a competitor, the free lunch ends.

rejectedAlternatives.name: OpenSEO
rejectedAlternatives.desc: A polished shell around DataForSEO, not a free web, keyword and backlink index; the data account starts with a fifty-dollar top-up.

notes: One of the best no examples: data moat is obvious once stated.
prompt:
Build me a daily rank tracker and site auditor for my own domain, the one slice
of Ahrefs worth building solo. Requirements:

- Python + httpx. Keywords live in keywords.txt, up to 50 terms; fetch positions
  from a SERP API (Serper.dev or SerpAPI, key in .env, free tiers cover a small
  list). Do not scrape Google directly, that just gets blocked.
- Store keyword, position, ranking URL, and date in SQLite; run daily from cron.
- A localhost dashboard (Flask + Chart.js): a sparkline per keyword and a
  biggest-movers-this-week list.
- A technical audit crawler for my domain: follow internal links, flag broken
  links, missing or duplicate titles and descriptions, redirect chains, and
  pages under 200 words; write findings to audit.md.
- Pull clicks and impressions per query from the Google Search Console API and
  show them beside the rank data. Warn me in the README: budget an hour for the
  Google Cloud console OAuth setup, it is the painful step.
- Local only, no accounts, no telemetry.
- Out of scope: backlink data, keyword volume and difficulty, and competitor
  research. Do not try to fake these by scraping; that dataset is the
  subscription.
- README: API key setup, the Search Console connection steps, and a plain
  statement that Ahrefs is a proprietary web index and this replaces the
  dashboard, not the data.
